title: 第134章 啊～是摄政王来了
slug: 我在战锤抽词条帝皇站起来了
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

卡班哈从王座上站了起来。

一边，是脸面，另一边，也是脸面。

卡班哈：“……”

好一个让魔左右为难啊。

黄铜巨影在坑底深处缓缓立起，像一座苏醒的山。

岩浆在它脚边翻涌，手中的巨斧屠夫之刃在亚空间能量的冲刷下亮如明镜。

它原本是打算等到那位帝国摄政到达之后再亲自登场的。

一个体面的符合大魔身份的华丽登场，踩着满地的尸骸和破碎的旗帜，让那位帝国摄政在他的子嗣们的尸体的顶点看见恐虐最凶猛的化身。

结果现在那位帝国摄政还没来呢，它的大军已经快要被清扫干净了。

而且以这种效率，它再坐一会儿，等会它出去之后就会变成一个光杆司令。

卡班哈：“……”

这到底是什么魔间疾苦？

不就是来打一打那些人类罐头吗？它是做错了什么吗？

卡班哈决定亲自出去看看。

看看，就看看，不一定以大欺小。

黄铜巨影继续向上走，每一步都带着不情不愿的沉重。

早知道这些下属这么没用，它来的时候就应该把它们都杀了，好过在这里给它丢人。

脚步很重，撞击坑底的岩层都在颤动。

脚下那些残存的恶魔慌不择路地给它让路，有的没有及时闪开就直接被它踩碎。

它脚步沉重地带着气一步一步往坑口走，每一步都让地面震颤得更厉害。

岩浆沿着它的足迹向外蔓延，把周围焦黑的岩壳重新烧得通红。

*******

外面，极限战士还在推进。

战团长的声音在通讯频道里响起：“全员注意！那东西要出来了！”

金光中央，林恩把真理权杖杵在地上。

他看向那个撞击坑的方向，能感受到有什么东西正在上升，带着火山爆发般的灵能波动和杀意，像一座核反应堆正在从地底上来。

——卡班哈出来了。

林恩倒吸了一口气。

完了，恶魔死的太多，提前把卡班哈引上来了。

基里曼还没有到。

凡人里边没有能和卡班哈对打的人物。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Kabanha stood up from his throne.

One side is face, the other side is face.

Kabanha: "..."

What a dilemma for the devil.

The giant brass shadow slowly stood up deep in the pit, like an awakening mountain.

Magma surged around its feet, and the giant axe-butcher's blade in its hand shone like a mirror under the wash of subspace energy.

It originally planned to wait until the imperial regent arrived before appearing in person.

A decent and magnificent appearance befitting the identity of a great demon, stepping on the corpses and broken banners on the ground, allowing the imperial regent to see the most ferocious incarnation of Khorne on the apex of the corpses of his heirs.

As a result, the imperial regent hasn't arrived yet, and its army is about to be wiped out.

And with this efficiency, if it sits for a while, it will become a polished commander when it goes out.

Kabanha: "..."

What kind of suffering is this?

Aren't you just here to hit a dozen of those human cans?Did it do something wrong?

Kabanha decided to go out and see for himself.

Take a look, just take a look, you don’t necessarily bully the small with the big.

The giant brass shadow continued to walk upwards, each step carrying a reluctant heaviness.

If it had known these subordinates were so useless, it should have killed them all when it came, rather than embarrassing it here.

The footsteps were so heavy that the rock formations at the bottom of the crater were shaking.

The remaining demons underfoot hurriedly gave way to it, and some were crushed by it without getting out of the way in time.

It walked towards the pit entrance step by step with heavy steps and breath, and every step made the ground tremble more violently.

The magma spreads outward along its footprints, burning the surrounding blackened rock crust red again.

*******

Outside, the Ultramarines were still advancing.

The Chapter Leader's voice rang through the communication channel: "Attention, everyone! That thing is coming out!"

In the center of the golden light, Lin En punched the scepter of truth on the ground.

He looked in the direction of the impact crater and could feel something rising, carrying spiritual energy fluctuations and murderous intent like a volcanic eruption, like a nuclear reactor rising from the ground.

——Kabanha came out.

Lynn gasped.

It's over, too many demons died, and Kabanha was lured up in advance.

Guilliman has not arrived yet.

There is no one among mortals who can fight with Kabanha.
